positive_snippets: Had a fantastic experience with our stay. The rooms are well maintained and comfortable the staff is courteous and polite and the service is excellent. Mr Deepak and Mr Piyush were extremely helpful and professional. Would highly recommend the place.

I had a really pleasant stay at Hays Air by Ahuja Residence. The overall experience was excellent, especially the room service which was prompt, professional, and very attentive to our needs. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making the stay very relaxing. The staff was courteous and always ready to help, which added to the positive experience.

Everything from check-in to the daily service was smooth and well-managed. The hospitality and attention to detail truly made the stay enjoyable.

Special thanks to Mr Akash who assisted us during the stay.

Note: This review is specifically for the Hays Air property only, and not for any other properties under Ahuja Residences.

I stayed at the new bulit property for almost 10 days. It's beautifully made, very clean and hygienic and the cleanliness is just next level.
Their Premium Suites are stunning and have all the amenities that you can think of. Their service is super swift and everyone in the staff is always willing to help you.
The breakfast is good but their food other than the breakfast is average. I would recommend ordering from outside.
5 stars to my stay overall and I would highly recommend this property.
